warnings: Ground-level framing under the two stairs only: one B2 line on row A (grid 2 to 3) and one on row B (grid 2 to 3), each split at the middle C1. The mark B2 is printed once per row (row A above the 2' column, row B below the 2'' column), so both segments of a row take it. Level from the view title (+0.00).

The middle C1 sits at 1.20 from grid 2 on row A (chain 1.20 + 1.30, 2') but at 1.30 on row B (chain 1.30 + 1.20, 2'') — read as printed, two different points. On row A the middle column is drawn with a dashed outline.

Stairs ST-01 (A-A'''' x 2-2', inside row A) and ST-02 (A''''''-B x 2''-3, inside row B) are drawn dashed; the S-03 ST-1 section shows the stair foot sitting on a B2 at ระดับดิน and its head on a B2 at the floor. Stair refs are approximate nearest points (section 10a). Only ST-1 is detailed (S-03); ST-02 has no section of its own.
No footing is printed under the 2' / 2'' columns on the footing plan.
